verified_feature_evidence.26.17.0_manualRead: Verified on iPhone primary and rootless iPad secondary across direct and group chats (selective read-mark for target message while keeping subsequent messages unread). Reply-read and visual exceptions verified on iPad without mutating global settings. Legacy getter projection readBoundary remains unsupported on 26.17.0.
verified_feature_evidence.26.17.0_unsendRetention: Verified on iPhone (direct and group chats) and rootless iPad secondary (group chats). Message body retention and cancelled marker persist across remote unsend and clean app restarts via verified 6-frame/16-anchor lookup.
verified_feature_evidence.26.17.0_replyReadGate: Prior KVO gate distinguishes success, failure, and stale boundary; normal-talk flow F unread, successful reply G marks F read, following H remains unread.
verified_feature_evidence.26.17.0_manualReadTaskClass: The task class uses a SwiftObject root; the native-root host fixture does not assume NSObject inheritance.
verified_feature_evidence.26.17.0_readerSheet: Primary (P_) and secondary (S_) reader sheets display resolved names; native group events and refreshes preserve recorded historical read timestamps while keeping exact, range, and observed states separated. PR19 fixed boundary overwrite regressions via additive range_at_ms migration without guessing lost provenance.
verified_feature_evidence.localFonts: TTF and OTF sample import, font registration, nativeBody chat rendering, and standard-font restoration device-verified.
verified_feature_evidence.themeSupport: Native theme application, preview, and restart retention verified on iPhone and rootless iPad. Native redownload recovery is verified on iPhone only; unowned direct shop routes remain disabled and aggregate shop eligibility remains unsupported on 26.17.0.
verified_feature_evidence.nativeThemeRegistrationRoots: NativeThemeRegistration.x strictly validates distinct roots: the app Application Support owned-theme SQLite database and explicitly mapped App Group package tree. ThemeAccountNamespace.h is the shared P_/S_ namespace-component validator, not the component that validates storage roots.
verified_feature_evidence.26.17.0_nativeThemeWorkflow: Verified on rootless iPad for fixed owned ThemeShop and StickerShop routes covering download, preview, MyThemes registration/apply, and post-restart persistence. Native redownload recovery remains verified on iPhone only.
verified_feature_evidence.26.17.0_nativeThemeRecovery: Verified on iPhone LINE 26.17.0 path: recovery removed and set aside both package assets and saved ZIP; native My Themes download arrow led to fresh package generation and re-apply. Original archive, standard-theme restoration via 「基本」を選び「適用する」, and standard font were restored, and temporary files cleaned.
verified_feature_evidence.nativeThemeResetSemantics: didTapResetButton edits and resets the currently selected theme rather than applying default theme; standalone RUINResetTheme has no source callers and its standalone behavior remains unestablished. Standard-theme restoration was verified by operation 「基本」を選び「適用する」 succeeding.
verified_feature_evidence.iPadRootlessUI: Verified on rootless iPad secondary for Navigation Push settings and standard Page Sheet presentation/dismissal. Font TTF/OTF device QA remains unverified on iPad (iPhone verified only); overall 26.17.0 host status remains unverified with startup warning retained.
verified_feature_evidence.walletTab: Wallet-tab-only hiding verified to survive returning from native settings on device; does not generalize across all tab combinations.
verified_feature_evidence.notifications: Background notification receipt recovery was not achieved on standalone iPhone; APNs support remains unconfirmed.
verified_feature_evidence.themeShopNumericScope: For LINE 26.16, shopEligibility, nativeReadAdapterStatus, and shopSchemeScopeStatus remain Verified. For LINE 26.17, nativeReadAdapterStatus is Verified across 22 validated anchors without Mach-O binary modifications, supporting StylesheetManager state retention and typed native caller chains for RUIN-owned fixed Theme, Sticker, and MyThemes endpoints. Execution is strictly constrained by Swift TaskLocal context propagation (typed monotonic request IDs, 12-second TTL, maximum 32 reads), leaving stored account roles immutable. Unowned generic routes remain Unverified (disabled), and aggregate shopEligibility remains Unsupported to prevent unverified bypasses.
verified_feature_evidence.fatDylibPackaging: Separate object directories build arm64 and arm64e with Swift compile and link targets set to iOS 18.0 for both slices; lipo produces a single fat dylib with ad-hoc signing verified via strict codesign. All three DEBs bundle the identical fat payload. Verification requires exactly these two slices with validated per-slice dependencies, passing distribution unit tests, synthetic and actual packaging checks.
verified_feature_evidence.nativeArchitectureQA: Bundling arm64 and arm64e slices does not establish runtime feature behavior in an arm64e LINE main process; known pristine and phone-QA LINE main executable files are arm64, runtime native LINE main ARM64 execution (subtype 0) is observed, and RUIN's own arm64 and arm64e slice loading is confirmed across runs, while arm64e main-process feature QA remains unverified. Injection and filter scope remains strictly LINE-only with system processes excluded, and rootless resources resolve adjacent to the dylib via dladdr.
verified_feature_evidence.authenticatedImportCompatibility: Proven PAC guard stops authenticated C import rebinding on arm64e; Keychain applies NativePassthrough (ready) across all architectures only when group mapping is empty and actual permission probes for both old app and shared groups return Allowed, whereas nonempty arm64e mapping halts before writing imports as UnsupportedAuthenticatedImports (not ready) with arm64 C compatibility retained; BundleIdentity independently uses NativePassthrough for original CF jp.naver.line bundles and preserves Objective-C identity projection on renamed arm64e bundles with only CF C rebinding marked UnsupportedAuthenticatedImports; device authentication tests have not been performed and no new runtime device proof is claimed.
verified_feature_evidence.26.17.0_secondaryLoginLongPress: UIControl hierarchy search and SwiftUI accessibility element with exact AX identifier login; host test suites passed for normal login, secondary login, and ABI mismatch detection, while real on-device authentication, actual login execution, and device mode switching remain unverified.
